verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say payroll connects with retirement plans to reduce duplicate work, and that employees can manage ADP retirement accounts from the employee portal. Together these point to a first-party retirement offering tied to payroll, but nothing explicitly documents 401(k) setup or contributions syncing automatically with each pay run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 401(k) plan offering and setup, automatic per-payroll contribution deduction and remittance, employer match handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll

citations.quote: Connect payroll with time tracking, benefits, retirement and other business tools when you need them, helping reduce duplicate work
